title: 第一部分 基础训练 TEST 5

sections.title: 阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Today, smartphones have become part of our daily life. So we want to tell kids about some free apps for learning.

* **NCERT Textbooks**
If you have this app called NCERT Textbooks on your smartphone, then all the textbooks from Grade 1 to Grade 12 will appear on this app at all times. Children in other grades can also increase their knowledge through this app.
* **Story Builder**
Story Builder is for kids who are good at English writing and reading but weak in speaking. The app teaches kids how to tell a story well. And an online teacher will give you a hand if necessary.
* **Earth Atlas**
Earth Atlas is an app for all students, especially those who love geography. It provides all types of information about places all over the world with lots of beautiful pictures and videos.
* **Math Tricks**
Math Tricks is for students who are worried about their math. The formulas (公式) given in this app make problems in math very easy. It can not only improve your skills, but make your learning fun as well because you can enjoy math in games.

questions.prompt: How many apps are shown in the text?
questions.translation: 这篇文章展示了几个应用程序？
questions.explanation: 文中介绍了 NCERT Textbooks、Story Builder、Earth Atlas 和 Math Tricks 共4款应用。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: An app called NCERT Textbooks can ________.
options: A. help children with their math problems
B. improve kids' writing and reading skills
C. provide online textbooks for the fifth graders
D. teach kids to tell stories and learn English well
questions.translation: 一款名为 NCERT Textbooks 的应用能够 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据文中“NCERT Textbooks”的介绍，该应用收录了从一到十二年级的全部课本，因此能为五年级学生提供在线课本。答案为C。

questions.prompt: Which app will he choose if a kid wants to know more about other countries?
questions.translation: 如果一个孩子想更多地了解其他国家，他会选择哪款应用？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“Earth Atlas”的介绍，它提供有关世界各地各种场所的信息，适合了解其他国家。答案为B。

questions.prompt: When using Math Tricks, you may find it ________.
questions.translation: 在使用 Math Tricks 时，你可能会觉得它 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据文中“make your learning fun as well because you can enjoy math in games”可知，它能让你觉得有趣。答案为D。

questions.prompt: What do these apps have in common?
options: A. They are all good for kids' learning.
B. They all provide pictures and videos.
C. They all make kids study in games.
D. They all help to improve writing skills.
questions.translation: 这几款应用有什么共同点？
questions.explanation: 全文介绍的几款应用都是用于学习的免费应用，都对孩子们的学习有帮助。答案为A。

sections.title: 阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
In America, if you see a group of students wearing crazy hats or summer T-shirts in the middle of winter, don't be surprised. They may be celebrating their School Spirit Week.

School Spirit Week is a time for students to celebrate their school's pride. This is not a break, but a festival. It can be held during any week of the year. The celebration is for all ages, from elementary school to high school, as long as the themes are meaningful.

School Spirit Week often has different themes that are followed throughout the week. During the week, students decorate the classrooms. Every day, there is a theme. This is also students' favorite part. They take part in different activities and have fun together.

School Spirit Week often encourages students to wear funny and fashionable clothes, with a different outfit for each day of the week. Monday might be a funny hat day, followed by Tuesday's Hawaiian shirt day and Wednesday's silly T-shirt day. Thursday could be a pajama (睡衣) day, followed by Friday's school color day.

There are also lots of other activities the students can take part in during School Spirit Week. Do you want to have School Spirit Week?

questions.prompt: School Spirit Week is a time for students to ________.
questions.translation: 校园精神周是学生们 ________ 的时刻。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第一句“School Spirit Week is a time for students to celebrate their school's pride.”可知，是为了庆祝学校的骄傲。答案为A。

questions.prompt: When is School Spirit Week held?
options: B. During any week of the year.
questions.translation: 校园精神周什么时候举行？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“It can be held during any week of the year.”可知，可在一年中的任意一周举行。答案为B。

questions.prompt: The third paragraph mainly talks about the ________ of School Spirit Week.
questions.translation: 第三段主要讲述了校园精神周的________。
questions.explanation: 第三段围绕“different themes that are followed throughout the week”展开，讲述一周中每天的主题。答案为B。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "outfit" mean?
questions.translation: 画线单词“outfit”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 根据后文“Monday might be a funny hat day...Wednesday's silly T-shirt day”可知，“outfit”指每天穿的衣服（Clothes）。答案为D。

questions.prompt: Which is NOT true about School Spirit Week according to the passage?
options: A. Students can wear crazy clothes.
B. Students can take part in different activities.
C. Students can rest at home for a week.
D. There are different themes in the week.
questions.translation: 根据文章，关于校园精神周以下哪项是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 文中明确说“This is not a break, but a festival.”，说明它不是一个假期，因此学生不能在家休息一周。答案为C。

sections.title: 阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
A high school student from India smiles when asked about his favorite subject. "Art," he says happily. He's not alone. Many of his classmates have a similar answer. Their art teacher Umapathy has taken many of them to the amazing world of craft (手工艺). Umapathy makes things from some waste such as dried leaves, vegetable waste and bamboo.

The 42-year-old teacher also raises awareness (意识) among students and villagers about sustainable livelihoods (可持续生计). He has been making a difference in the lives of students for the past 13 years. Encouraged by his work, many students and villagers have become interested in craft. And many have even made it their jobs.

Making artwork has helped several students from poor families. The students, with the help of Umapathy, have saved enough money for their education. Some even decide to study art at college.

It all began when Umapathy started teaching art at the high school. He realized that students from poor families were not able to buy materials (材料) to make artwork. "That's when I turned to natural products to provide them with a chance of making artwork through products that are easily got at no cost," says Umapathy.

In the future, Umapathy wishes all his students can work hard and make their dreams come true.

questions.prompt:
What does Umapathy use to make artwork?
① Bamboo.
② New boxes.
③ Dried leaves.
④ Vegetable waste.
⑤ Fresh fruit.
questions.translation:
乌马帕蒂用什么制作工艺品？
①竹子。②新盒子。③干树叶。④蔬菜废料。⑤新鲜水果。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段最后和第三段“Umapathy makes things from some waste such as dried leaves, vegetable waste and bamboo.”可知，他用竹子、干树叶和蔬菜废料制作工艺品，即①③④。答案为D。

questions.prompt: When did Umapathy start to make a difference in students' lives?
questions.translation: 乌马帕蒂是什么时候开始对学生的人生产生影响的？
questions.explanation: 文中提到“The 42-year-old teacher...has been making a difference...for the past 13 years.”，即他42岁，已坚持13年，42－13＝29，因此他29岁开始产生影响。答案为B。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: A. Umapathy helped lots of students study art at college.
B. Some students changed their life by making artwork.
C. Villagers made a lot of money by selling artwork.
D. A lot of students had to leave school to make money.
questions.translation: 根据文章，以下哪项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“Making artwork has helped several students from poor families...have saved enough money for their education.”可知，一些学生通过制作工艺品改变了生活。答案为B。

questions.prompt: Which of the following could best describe Umapathy?
questions.translation: 以下哪项最能描述乌马帕蒂？
questions.explanation: 他变废为宝（聪明clever），并无偿帮助贫困学生（善良kind），因此“Clever and kind”最贴切。答案为C。

questions.prompt: What can be the best title for the passage?
options: B. More people become interested in art
C. The age can't stop Umapathy's love for art
D. An art teacher helps his students through art from waste
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 全文讲述乌马帕蒂用废弃物制作工艺品并帮助贫困学生的故事，因此D项“一位美术老师用废弃物做的艺术品帮助学生”最合适。答案为D。

sections.title: 阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
The slow train No. 5609/5610 in Southwest China has drawn people's attention recently. It's a public-welfare (公益性) slow train that runs between Chongqing and Xiushan county.

In some carriages (车厢) of the train, desks and chairs next to the windows take the place of seats. They are "study carriages" for passengers in need. The Chinese characters (汉字) "Yu Yue" appear on the train. It means "traveling and reading happily". Other encouraging words can be seen throughout the "study carriages".

Besides No. 5609/5610, other slow trains also have "study carriages", including No. 5619/5620 and No. 5633/5634 which run along the Chengdu-Kunming Railway. Students from nearby schools often take the trains between school and home. The trains are their "school buses" and many students use their travel time to complete homework.

On train No. Z150, which runs between Guiyang and Beijing, a "book bar" carriage has been welcomed by college students. There are nearly 400 universities and colleges in the cities along the line, making train No. Z150 the first choice for most of the students. Since 2015, the train's dining car has been open for free at night. It provides students with free tea and other services.

These small actions by the railway department not only make the students feel comfortable, but also help them continue their studies. Do you want to take one of the trains above? Have a try! You will have a wonderful trip.

questions.prompt: What does "Yu Yue" mean according to Paragraph 2?
questions.translation: 根据第二段，“渝阅”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“It means 'traveling and reading happily'.”可知，意为“快乐地旅行和阅读”。答案为B。

questions.prompt: What can we know from the text?
options: A. We can see "study carriages" on any slow trains.
B. No. Z150's dining car began to open for free all day in 2015.
C. The Chinese characters "Yu Yue" appear on train No. Z150.
D. The slow train No. 5633/5634 runs between Chengdu and Kunming.
questions.translation: 从文章中我们能了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“including No. 5619/5620 and No. 5633/5634 which run along the Chengdu-Kunming Railway.”可知，5633/5634次列车运行于成都至昆明（成昆铁路）之间。答案为D。

questions.prompt: Which train provides a "book bar" carriage?
questions.translation: 哪趟列车提供“书吧”车厢？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“a 'book bar' carriage has been welcomed by college students”对应的列车为Z150。答案为A。

questions.prompt: How might the students feel about "study carriages"?
questions.translation: 学生们对“学习车厢”的感觉可能是怎样的？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“...help them continue their studies.”可知，学习车厢对学生很有帮助（用新意）。答案为C。

questions.prompt: What does the text mainly talk about?
options: A. Best services on slow trains.
B. The lines of four slow trains.
C. A slow train with a library.
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要谈论什么？
questions.explanation: 全文围绕多趟慢速列车（包括Z150）上的“学习车厢”和“书吧”车厢展开，属于慢车上的“学习车厢”这一话题。答案为D。

sections.title: 任务型阅读 E
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容回答问题。
sections.passage:
The ancient Chinese divided (划分) a year into 24 solar terms (节气). Start of Winter, the 19th solar term of the year, began on November 8, 2023.

Start of Winter is the first solar term of winter. It means winter is coming and crops harvested in autumn should be stored up. Here are some special traditions about Start of Winter.

Yifan Festival is one of the most important festivals of the Mulam ethnic group in Guangxi. It is held around Start of Winter every three to five years and lasts one to three days. It includes many activities such as traditional blessing ceremonies, cultural performances and a folk song party.

On the first day of Start of Winter, there is a tradition, "nourishing the winter (补冬)", in Southeast China in places such as Fujian, Guangdong and Taiwan provinces. To prepare for the coming cold winter and keep strong and healthy, people there like to eat high-calorie (高热量) food such as chicken, duck, beef, mutton, and fish. They are cooked with some Chinese medicines.

People in Wuxi have a tradition of eating tuanzi on the first day of Start of Winter. Tuanzi is a kind of traditional Chinese food made with the newly-harvested rice. It can be sweet or salty, and it tastes delicious. Most farmers make tuanzi by themselves, while people in the city buy ready-made tuanzi.

questions.prompt: When did Start of Winter start in 2023?
questions.translation: 2023年的立冬是什么时候开始的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Start of Winter...began on November 8, 2023.”可知，2023年立冬于11月8日开始。

questions.prompt: How often is Yifan Festival held?
options: B. Every three to five years.
questions.translation: 依饭节多久举行一次？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“It is held around Start of Winter every three to five years...”可知，大约每三到五年举行一次。

questions.prompt: What do people in Fujian like to eat to "nourish the winter"?
options: A. High-calorie food such as chicken, duck, beef, mutton and fish.
B. Fresh vegetables and fruits only.
C. Low-fat food such as noodles and porridge.
D. Sweet food such as cakes and ice cream.
questions.translation: 福建人喜欢吃什么来“补冬”？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“people there like to eat high-calorie food such as chicken, duck, beef, mutton, and fish.”可知，他们吃鸡、鸭、牛、羊和鱼等高热量食物。

questions.prompt: What is tuanzi made with?
questions.translation: 团子是用什么做的？
questions.explanation: 根据第五段“Tuanzi is a kind of traditional Chinese food made with the newly-harvested rice.”可知，是用新收获的大米做的。

questions.prompt: What's the title of the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 全文围绕“立冬（Start of Winter）”展开，介绍了立冬的含义和各个地区围绕立冬展开的特殊传统，因此标题可定为“Start of Winter”。
